name: Shirlington Hearth
tagline: Neighborhood café by day, wine bar by night.
description: Shirlington Hearth is a fictional neighborhood café and wine bar used to demonstrate the studio's accessible, fast venue websites. Espresso and pastries in the morning, small plates and Virginia wines in the evening.
venue_accessibility: Accessible restroom on the main floor.

newsletter.consent_text: Yes, email me Shirlington Hearth news, events and offers. I can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email.
